name: Isekai World VN
source:
A visual novel made for the group chat "Isekai world" on Facebook Messenger.

The story and characters were made using assets from different anime.

[Based on Google Play]
translation:
这是一部为Facebook Messenger群聊“Isekai world”制作的视觉小说。

故事和角色使用了多部不同动画作品的素材。

[据Google Play内容编写]
